prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, audience and compliance needs. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me recommend agencies that match your needs:

- What type of organization are you (hospital or health system, private practice, specialty clinic, medical device/pharma, B2B healthcare services)?
- What services do you need (brand/positioning, patient acquisition/paid media, SEO/content, PR, creative/TV, physician recruitment, trade marketing, digital product UX, regulatory/FDA support)?
- Geographic focus (only St. Louis patients/clinics, regional, national)?
- Budget range and timeline?
- Any must-haves (HIPAA/FDA experience, bilingual outreach, EHR integration)?

If you want to start searching yourself, here’s a short checklist and process to find a top fit:

How to evaluate candidates
- Relevant healthcare experience (examples of similar clients: hospitals, clinics, device makers, etc.)
- Measurable results and case studies (patient volume increases, lead cost, conversions)
- Regulatory/compliance expertise (HIPAA, FDA/pharma restrictions when relevant)
- Team seniority and stability (who will actually do the work)
- Full-service vs. specialty fit (creative + media buying + analytics vs. only SEO)
- Reporting & KPIs (clear dashboards, cadence, attribution model)
- Client references and retention history
- Pricing model and estimated ROI
- Local knowledge vs. national reach (local agencies may know the St. Louis market; national firms bring healthcare specialization at scale)

Suggested questions to ask agencies
- Tell me about two relevant healthcare campaigns and the specific results (KPIs).
- How do you handle HIPAA/FDA regulatory review in creative and messaging?
- Who will be on our account and what are their backgrounds?
- How do you measure and attribute patient acquisition and lifetime value?
- What is your onboarding process and typical timeline for a campaign launch?
- Can you provide 2–3 references from similar clients?

Where to find reputable candidates
- Healthcare marketing award lists (Healthcare Advertising Awards, MM+M Awards)
- Review sites (Clutch, G2) and LinkedIn
- St. Louis Business Journal / local marketing groups for regional shops
- Recommendations from peers in healthcare systems or physician networks

If you want, tell me the answers to the quick questions above and I’ll recommend 3–5 agencies (local and national options) that fit your needs and budget, and I can draft a short RFP template to send them. Which would you prefer?
